question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to be reused as is in relation to reuse?
data_point: ability of the product to be reused as is
description: The ability of a product to be reused as is in relation to reuse refers to the product not undergoing any process beyond checking, cleaning, or repairing in order to prepare it for reuse for construction purposes without any additional pre-processing.
